b.speaker: voice
b.text: Miss Moreno. We admired your work on HOTSHOT. What happened to the picture was unfortunate. What happened to Tommy was... useful.

c.speaker: voice
c.text: There's a package outside your door. Inside is a key to room 204 at the Sunset Palms, Barstow. The night manager is keeping something that belonged to your brother.

d.speaker: voice
d.text: Be there before midnight. Wear the star. The people inside will understand what that means.

p2.speaker: machine
p2.text: We're sorry. The number you have dialed is not in service.

k1.speaker: cass
k1.text: Gold greasepaint. A key to room 204. A Polaroid of Tommy I've never seen.

k2.speaker: cass
k2.text: He's smiling. Tommy hated having his picture taken.

k3.speaker: narration
k3.text: She paints the star over her eye. In the mirror, it looks less like makeup than a mark.
